'''2001 Austrian National Championship''' was a Star Wars CCG national championship held in Austria in 2001.<ref name="dt-15620">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/15620 My TIGH Scouts at Austrian Championship], DeckTech (Michael "Mr.Monnok" Krobath, 28 April 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/15620/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/15620/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Dates:''' 2001 (before 28 April)
* '''Site:''' Austria
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Winner:''' —

The event is known from players' DeckTech posts; they give no exact date. It was played before the [[Tatooine (expansion)|Tatooine]] expansion was released on 30 May 2001.

== Results ==

Results below come from players' own DeckTech deck posts. Each row cites the post that gives it. A Dark or Light cell shows — until the deck page is linked.

{| class="wikitable"
|-

| 5th || [[Michael Krobath]]<ref name="dt-15620" /> || My Kind Of Scum || [[2001 Austrian National Championship Michael Krobath My TIGH Scouts at Austrian Championship|There Is Good In Him]]
|}

Krobath finished 5th. His Light There Is Good In Him deck went 3–0 (two full wins and one modified win) against two My Kind Of Scum decks and a Court deck; his Dark My Kind Of Scum deck won one of its three games, all against Watch Your Step. He counted four Watch Your Step decks in the field.<ref name="dt-15620" />
